external/mcp.txt

WHAT THIS IS
  Claude Code's registration of our MCP server ("cowork") on each laptop. The server's code is
  mcp/src/server.ts in repo 1. The registration is the per-laptop setting that tells Claude Code to
  start that server for sessions in the demo-app clone. It lives in Claude Code's own config
  (local scope), not in any repo.

WHO / WHEN
  A puts the command into hooks/src/install.ts (Sat 20:00). Every teammate then runs install on
  their own laptop.

HOW (install.ts does this; here's the manual version)
  Run it from inside your demo-app clone, because local scope belongs to that folder:
    claude mcp add --scope local cowork -- node <repo 1>/node_modules/tsx/<tsx bin> <repo 1>/mcp/src/server.ts
  <tsx bin>: the "bin" path in <repo 1>/node_modules/tsx/package.json.
  Why node plus a script path: on Windows, .cmd shims (npx, tsx.cmd) can't be started without a shell.
  Check the exact flag order with `claude mcp add --help` if the command is rejected.

CHECK IT WORKS
  - `claude mcp list` (from the demo-app clone) shows cowork.
  - In a Claude session there, /mcp shows cowork connected, with the tools post_intent,
    team_status and pull_teammate.
  - The agent's card in the UI turns online.

IF IT FAILS
  - "Failed to connect": run the same command yourself in a terminal; our errors go to stderr.
  - Anything our server prints to stdout breaks the protocol. Log with console.error only.
  - Start over: claude mcp remove --scope local cowork, then add it again.
